lines.text: Per Weapon mode. Now on Xbox.
Most scripts give one anti-recoil per category. Per Weapon gives every weapon its own.
On Xbox, it reads your controller's vibration instead of a PS5 trigger.
You need an Xbox controller, with vibration enabled, on console or PC, and in the game.
Open the Cronus menu. Go to Combat, Weapon Detect, and enable it.
Press A. Set Device to Xbox, and Type to Per Weapon.
Two new rows appear: Teach Weapon, and Tolerance.
Unlike PS5, nothing is known out of the box.
Until you teach a weapon, firing shows nothing. Your profile's manual setting is used instead.
Open Teach Weapon, and pick an empty slot.
Fire two or three times. The screen shows your controller's vibration values.
Once they're stable, confirm, pick a category, and save.
Fire it again, and it claims its own slot, automatically.
Too high or too low? Hold LT, and press Up or Down, while firing.
It's permanent, for that exact weapon.
Two taught weapons feel too similar? Hold LT, and press Left or Right, to switch.
Vibration drifts more than a PS5 trigger, shot to shot.
Tolerance sets the margin. Too tight, and a weapon just isn't recognized.
Too loose, and it confidently applies the wrong weapon's setting.
When in doubt, keep it tight.
Forty eight personal slots, kept after a power off, and a reflash.
Badly tuned mid fight? Hold View and Y, for one second, to fall back to your profile.
The full guide is on Rocket Mod dot org.
Rocket Mod. Per Weapon. On Xbox.
